title: Modernize Quickstart landing visuals: hero, runtime diagram, and step flow
creator: Avery Chen
description: Design refresh for the Quickstart landing page to improve clarity for new developers, reduce time-to-first-call, and provide visual parity across Hosted / Dedicated / Private deployment docs. Primary deliverables: a modern hero that showcases an interactive code + device screenshot, a simplified runtime diagram explaining request routing/caching/batching, and a three-step onboarding flow with accessible microcopy and responsive screenshot variants.
tasks: Audit existing quickstart assets in docs and Console (identify 6 screens to capture)
Collect reference patterns from competitors and internal marketing (inspiration board)
Create Figma hero variants: code + screenshot, horizontal split, mobile-first stacked
Design a constrained runtime diagram (SVG) that explains routing, KV cache, and fallback models in 3 lanes
Define screenshot recipes and capture checklist (resolution, tokens redaction, environment flags)
Export assets in light/dark themes + accessible color tokens and add to design system
Prepare dev handoff with component specs, storybook examples, and image assets
Coordinate with engineering to add analytics hooks for quickstart CTA and measure time-to-first-call

acceptance_criteria: Hero variants completed in Figma (desktop, tablet, mobile) and approved by PM
Runtime diagram exported as optimized SVG + PNG fallback and embedded in docs with alt text
Three-step onboarding flow has responsive screenshots for Hosted / Dedicated / Private and accessible microcopy
Assets uploaded to Drive/Design System with naming conventions and usage notes
Design handoff completed with component specs, CSS token recommendations, and Storybook examples
PM and ENG signoff obtained and images optimized for docs CDN before release
decisions: Keep quickstart to three steps (Install > First Call > Verify) to lower cognitive load
Create two-layer runtime diagram: a simple top-level view for the quickstart and an expandable detailed view in advanced docs
Use monospaced code window with live-like animated cursor for hero to emphasize instant dev feedback
Export all screenshots at 2x retina resolution and provide SVGs for diagrams to support scaling
notes: Risk: UI changes in Console could invalidate screenshots post-release. Mitigation: include capture script and tagging in repo so screenshots can be re-generated as part of release checklist.
Coordinate with security to ensure no API keys are present in screenshots. Include overlay/placeholder pattern in capture recipe.
Performance constraint: CDN image budget requires under 500KB per hero image; prefer SVGs + compressed PNG fallbacks.
